content: npm-published MCP servers: bin target needs #!/usr/bin/env node shebang; npm generates .cmd/.ps1 shims on Windows but clients spawning 'npx' directly hit spawn ENOENT because npx.cmd needs a shell — documented fix is command: cmd, args: ['/c','npx','-y',pkg]; SDK is ESM-only so package must be type:module with correct exports; npx cold start downloads the tree (5-30s first run) which can trip client startup timeouts; always document -y; claim the npm name/scope early (squatting) and prefer a scoped @org/name.
